summary: ADR-0058 accepted 2026-08-18; Acceptance-owned persisted runs, action DAG/events, command registries, route projections, and receipts are authoritative evidence; requests identify only target plan and prepared run input; caller route/lifecycle claims lack authority; action results must bind run, event, registry, candidate, contract, Knowledge, Skill-input, and validator identities; v2 request data is historical-only; inconsistent graphs, receipts, or unregistered actions are rejected; coordinator is reentrant/replayable; Acceptance alone owns acceptance-passed; no Bootstrap ownership, automatic start, release, or commit authority granted; scope is persisted evidence ownership only
